Legacy identity: `FOS-000011`. Original source: [immutable historical definition](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/73f891d6c0cf498ac92e804d7d0f0cd344a083f5/local-docs/reviews/observability-sweep.md).

Shared requirements and grouping: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8. All original criteria below remain required. Source status statements below describe their historical revision; current delivery evidence is recorded separately. Original relative links are resolved below.

## Original definition (verbatim)

11. **FOS-000011 — Expose discovery and selection completeness.** **M; depends on `FOS-000009`; §2.** [stream scanning:1200](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/fossilize_db.cpp#L1200) intentionally salvages truncated tails (E9). Database composites may omit unavailable inputs; whitelists/ranges and replay-cache checks change observable work. Return preparation/discovery metadata: requested/opened inputs, excluded inputs/items with policy, selected logical scope, truncation/read failures, complete/unknown discovery. Keep salvage behavior and report its limits. **Check:** intact empty archive versus truncated archive with zero retained entries; missing optional versus required subdatabase; filters and ranges. Known processed items cannot establish full coverage when unread scope is unknown. A caller may explicitly accept a recovered prefix, but the report must name that scope.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **Database/discovery integration tests:** E9 reports incomplete discovery even with zero retained items, while an intact empty archive reports known complete empty scope. The intact prefix remains readable; required missing/unreadable inputs prevent full-scope success.
   - **Selection/policy table tests:** Ranges, whitelists, deliberately optional inputs and explicitly accepted recovered-prefix policy report the exact selected/excluded scope and policy. Unknown unread totals remain unknown, never zero or full coverage; excluded items are not counted as failures or successes.
